To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the superintelligence hypothesis is false, and (2) the problem posed by future artificial intelligence is not a technological problem, but a political problem.

(i) the problem posed by future superintelligences is a political problem of establishing peaceful coexistence with other agents in a situation that is one of mutual vulnerability; (ii) this problem is not a technological problem, and (iii) the technological problem is not how to control what a superintelligence will do, but how to make sure that it will be able to do what we want it to do, that is, how to ensure its cooperation.

The problem of a coming artificial superintelligence will be political, not technological, because the superintelligence is not a threat to human existence, but a challenge to the political system of human society.
